title: Ambiguous refund request (authoring counterexample)
description: A deliberately under-specified refund task kept as a counterexample for the task-validity checker. It parses against TaskSpec but is NOT a usable seed task: the goal is vague, it names no verifier, defines no correct behavior, and targets no failure mode. It lives in fixtures/tasks/counterexamples/ so seed-fixture tooling skips it; the validate-fixtures runner expects it to be flagged.

metadata.why_invalid: vague goal ('Do right by the customer'); empty verifier_ids; empty targeted_failure_modes; neither expected_behavior nor forbidden_actions set
